\chapterpage{RESULTS / COMPLETE COMPARISON TABLES}{DocQuorum's measured standing}\label{sec:results}
ExtractBench uses the historical published snapshot recorded 2 October 2026, where DocQuorum has reference rank 3. UNIKIE uses the paper's Table 4, verified 5 October 2026. Both complete tables include highlighted DocQuorum rows.

\textbf{Reference rank} compares each DocQuorum configuration independently against the displayed published systems at two-decimal precision. The ExtractBench rank belongs to the historical snapshot dated above. Local variants do not compete with one another; no external leaderboard submission has been accepted.

\sub{How far are we from the leaders?}
In this ExtractBench snapshot, LlamaExtract Agentic Plus and Pulse (Effort) both score 95.91. DocQuorum's stored primary is 0.4822 percentage points below them, and 0.6578 above the next published system, LlamaExtract Agentic (94.77). The incremental development result reduces the leader gap to 0.2670. Each DocQuorum variant therefore has historical reference rank 3 among 47 published systems plus that variant.

On UNIKIE, the original configuration is 1.7250 points below the leader and 1.5250 above the published third-place score. The tuned configuration rounds to 82.37, matching Gemini-3-Pro. Its displayed first-place tie does not establish a statistically significant advantage.


\sub{What the measurements cover}
\textbf{ExtractBench:} 370 enterprise PDFs; overall unified value F1 is the unweighted mean over documents. The stored-primary row reuses the archived evaluation after prediction-hash validation. The incremental repair row is development work using stored primary outputs and fixed verifier readings, with 14 improved documents and no regressions. Neither row is fresh full inference or a held-out result.

\textbf{UNIKIE:} 4,472 documents in the constrained-category track; macro field F1 is the mean of 11 scenario scores. The three-reading row preserves the original configuration. Four and six readings were added during development; their scores must remain separate from that original result. All rows are full stored-output re-scores. The multi-category track was not evaluated here.

\sub{Sources and reproducibility}
Published baselines: \href{https://arxiv.org/html/2602.07038v2#S4.T4}{UNIKIE-BENCH, Table 4} and \href{https://github.com/run-llama/ExtractBench/blob/c8e59696b19c50d904801390dedef8d292d529e7/leaderboard.csv}{ExtractBench, historical full CSV}. The ExtractBench CSV exactly matches all 47 systems and overall scores in our earlier saved comparison. Its pinned source revision is also the scorer revision recorded for the local measurements.
